1.0 INTRODUCTION:

1.1 To provide the guidelines of Hospital formulary

2.0 SCOPE:-Hospital wide

3.0 RESPONSIBILTY:

3.1 Chairman

3.2 Committee head

3.3 committee members

3.4 Pharmacists

3.5 All doctors

4.0 ABBREVIATION:

4.1 NABH : National Accreditation Board for Hospitals and Healthcare providers

4.2 MOM : Management of Medication

4.3 EDL : Essential Drug list

5.0 DEFINITION: A continually revised compilation of approved pharmaceuticals, plus important ancillary information, which reflects the current clinical judgment of the institution's medical staff.

6.0 REFERENCE:

6.1 NABH: Accreditation Standards for Ayurveda Hospitals 2nd Edition April 2016.

7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS:

7.1 A list of medication appropriate for the patients and organization’s resources is developed.

7.2 The list is developed collaboratively by the multidisciplinary committee.

7.3 The formulary is available for clinicians to refer and adhere to.

7.4 There is a define process for acquisition of these medications.

7.5 There is a defined process for preparations of these medications.

7.6 There is a process to obtain medications not listed in the formulary.

8.0 POLICY & PROCEDURE:

8.1 Refer to Hospital drug formulary from manual.

8.2 The list is made of pharmacy and therapeutic committee by taking reference of EDL from AYUSH and hospital need.

8.3 Drug formulary is available in all wards and to all Clinical HODs to refer and to adhere to it.

8.4 Refer to- procurement process from manual.

8.5 The medications which can be prepared in In-House pharmacy are approved and analyzed by subject expert as per Ayurveda principles of formulation’s analytical testing at Vishal Ayurved Parv Hospital Rasashala are defined. And also revised from time to time as per hospital needs and demand. Medicine required for Panchakarma will be made as per Panchakarma SOPs.

8.6 The medicine which are not listed in formulary, are prescribed to the patient for procurement from outside pharmacy in emergency. If not emergency it will be procured as per policy mentioned in manual.
